description: This dataset from Israel's Ministry of Environmental Protection lists green buildings in the planning and construction process that are being built to the Israeli green building standard SI 5281. The information comes from laboratories approved to test compliance with SI 5281, under the conditions of the ministry's procedure 12-2020-01 on passing laboratory information for publication, and shows the dates on which approvals were given and the level of compliance of each building tested. Coverage: Israel, for buildings that went through an approved laboratory. Access: one CSV on the national open data portal, with the CKAN API, free; the resource was last updated on 24 September 2026. Licence: not stated on the dataset page. Caveats: the ministry states that the valid information is always what appears in the certificates the laboratory gave to the building tested; the list covers buildings in the certification process, not the whole stock, and the page is in Hebrew. Simulation uses are a register of certified green buildings for energy, heat and climate adaptation studies and for tracking regulation uptake. Related records: the Australian building energy efficiency register.
